summary: StudentDocuments manages student-uploaded documents in a web application, supporting workflows for adding, editing, deleting, and withholding documents. It enforces document type restrictions, anonymizes uploaded files, and provides business rules around document visibility, retention, and profile information.
purpose: To facilitate students and authorized staff in uploading, managing, viewing, and deleting documents tied to student profiles, including resumes (named/anonymous), photos, and other documents, with privacy, anonymity, retention, and consent controls.

workflows.name: Upload Student Document
steps: User selects document type from available codes (excluding special types based on conditions).
User provides document details (name, comments, delete-after date, anonymity).
Document name is anonymized using student ID and timestamp.
File is uploaded and saved to a uniquely named folder.
Document metadata is created and saved.
If editing, previous document file is deleted.

workflows.name: Edit Student Document
steps: User selects document from GridView.
FormView switches to Edit mode with populated details.
User updates fields and saves.
Type restrictions enforced (special types disabled).
Document metadata and file updated.

workflows.name: Delete Student Document
steps: User triggers delete from UI.
Document metadata and file deleted.
UI updates to reflect removal.

workflows.name: Withhold Document
steps: User triggers withhold.
Document is marked withhold in metadata.
Withheld indicator is shown in GridView.

workflows.name: Release Withhold
steps: User triggers release.
Withhold flag removed from metadata.
UI updates indicator.

workflows.name: Student Profile Management
steps: User edits/deletes web page information for profile.
Profile changes saved and rebound to UI.

business_rules: Photo documents are not shown/uploaded if user is the student (unless in Student Welcome mode), or if a photo already exists.
Resume-named and resume-anon codes are restricted based on what already exists.
Document names are anonymized to remove student identity.
Delete-after date is required only if certain radio buttons checked.
Special document types cannot be changed once set.
Document visibility depends on user role and program consent.
Instructor/Course Leader document visibility depends on program settings.
validations: Document upload regex validation for allowed file types.
Checks for non-null fields when editing certain fields.
calculations: Anonymized file name generation: 'HSPnet' + StudentID + '-' + timestamp.
File size determined from uploaded file.
conditions: Show internal documents if FromStudentWelcome or allowed by role and program.
Hide photo upload if student is uploading or photo already exists.
Hide resume upload if already exists.
Show delete-after fields only for certain roles or checked radio buttons.
Enable or disable document type dropdown based on current type.
system_behavior: Dynamic UI updates based on user session, document existence, and edit mode.
Startup scripts and JavaScript variables injected based on session and role.
GridView and FormView controls switch modes and update datasource dynamically.
Handles async and regular postbacks for UI updates.
dependencies: UserSession determines access, available codes, and visible fields.
CodeRecord collection determines allowed document types.
Program consent settings affect visibility for staff roles.
exceptions: Administrative setup errors if code cannot be found.
Null exceptions for checkbox evaluations in markup for Insert mode.
File upload errors handled and flagged through UI validators.
